source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.4「機体の動力源」(1)機体の動力源

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 電動機とエンジン機は飛行時間・距離と振動・騒音に代表的なtradeoffがある。
evidence.tested_misconception: 電動/engineの特徴を逆に覚える、または差がないと考える。
evidence.reasoning_path: mission endurance/noise -> compare power sources -> tradeoff

collision.note: LOW。Q060はairframe typeの効率比較で、power-source tradeoffは未出。

independent_review.rationale: 4.4 contrasts electric and engine power sources on vibration/noise versus endurance/range; distinct from Q060 airframe-type efficiency.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
